source.post_text:
Twins checked in on Zach Neto multiple times at trade deadline, per @nightengalejr.

Talks never gained traction because asking price started with Walker Jenkins.

Twins were also in talks with Blue Jays for Kevin Gausman before he was traded to the Cubs.

replies.text: Who in the fuck do the Angels think Neto is? 🤣🤣🤣
replies.author: @Firefighter4547

replies.text: Classic twins asking for too much and getting nothing
replies.author: @moody_museui

replies.text: The asking price for someone hitting .226 was the twins number one prospect 😂? No wonder the Angels never do shit. They have the most delusional front office in the league.
replies.author: @Stephenash26

replies.text: The Angels setting the floor at Walker Jenkins for Neto explains why those talks stalled so quickly, though it does show the Twins were shopping around.
replies.author: decoy

decoy_rationale: The reply has an oddly balanced and slightly explanatory tone that hedges between criticizing the ask and noting the Twins' activity.
